description: Inspect the skills the AI chat runtime reads

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List every skill with its scope, read count and last use

subcommands.name: path
subcommands.description: Print the path of a skill's SKILL.md

subcommands.name: trust
subcommands.description: Show whether this repository's skills are trusted

subcommands.name: untrust
subcommands.description: Forget the trust decision for this repository

subcommands.name: pending
subcommands.description: List skill changes staged for review

subcommands.name: diff
subcommands.description: Show what a staged change would write

subcommands.name: approve
subcommands.description: Apply a staged change, after confirmation

subcommands.name: reject
subcommands.description: Discard a staged change, after confirmation

subcommands.name: archive
subcommands.description: Hide a personal skill from the prompt without deleting it

subcommands.name: unarchive
subcommands.description: Bring an archived personal skill back

subcommands.name: pin
subcommands.description: Exempt a personal skill from auto-archiving
